# Synthetic standard-spectrum time series

Twelve deterministic standard PNN9 frames derived from the sanitized PyPNM
spectrum fixture. Timestamps and levels are SYNTHETIC, including a moving peak.
These are UI/math demonstration data, not real temporal modem measurements.

Open from Spectrum Analyzer → Min-Avg-Max or Playback. All acquisition settings
remain identical. MAC: 00:ca:00:00:00:01. Times advance by five seconds.

Reproduce with the generate_spectrum_demo Rust example and a new output folder.
The upstream fixture LICENSE/NOTICE/provenance are included.
